description.text: We make crowdfunded video game documentaries for everyone to enjoy. Our mission is to tell authentic stories about video games, the people who make them, and those who play them. Our work is funded by a community of Patrons and free of sponsored content. Subscribe to this channel to get access to our docs the moment they go live.
